description: This file defines a specific culture info object for the Sami (Northern) language in Norway, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and date manipulation functions. It appears to be part of the DateJS library with culture-specific customizations.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a weekday in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the date within the month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is currently observing daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts the date to ISO string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the date.
